name: eMACS J0429.0-1011 (Hubble)
blurb: eMACS J0429.0-1011, a massive galaxy cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: emacsj042901011-hubble
story: A distant, massive cluster of galaxies, first found in an all-sky X-ray survey. Clusters like this act as powerful lenses for studying galaxies in the very distant universe.

claims.text: eMACS J0429.0-1011 is an eMACS cluster with HST F110W and F140W imaging
eMACS clusters were discovered in ROSAT All-Sky Survey X-ray data
Such clusters act as powerful lenses to study galaxies in the very distant Universe
Program 15843 is a snapshot survey of the most massive clusters of galaxies at z=0.5-1; EMACSJ0429.0-1011 is target 76
